subject: Temporary KV/log hold & backup prune conditions - Helios Therapeutics
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@helioshealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: contracting@helioshealth.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Request: temporary retain of inference KV logs (Helios)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Helios is excited about Redwood’s latency guarantees. One item that came up in legal/security review: for an initial 6-month pilot we need a short-term exception to the default ephemeral KV/log retention so our engineering team can debug model behavior and run reproducibility checks.

Specifically we are asking:
- Retain request/response KV logs and associated metadata for up to 90 days (instead of the default 7 days).
- Ensure those logs are segregated and accessible only via an agreed runbook and audit pathway.
- Provide a backup purge schedule and an attestation that backups containing those logs will be removed within 30 days of a purge call.

Attached is a short questionnaire from our DPO (Helios-DPA-Questionnaire.xlsx) and a high-level requirement doc. Can Redwood confirm feasibility and list any subprocessors that will touch these logs (including locations)? We also need the proposed runbook for how Helios can request temporary access, and how redaction/deletion is enforced after the 90-day window.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Carter
Director, Product Security
Helios Therapeutics

[Attachment: Helios-DPA-Questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@helioshealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 10:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retain of inference KV logs (Helios)

Emily — thanks for the clear asks and the questionnaire. Looping in Kimberly (security/compliance) and Marissa (customer success / ops) to validate runbook details and subprocessor exposures.

High-level: we can support a 90-day temporary retention for KV/log artifacts for pilot customers under an exception flow, but there are three operational controls we need to confirm up-front:
1) Scoped retention bucket: logs must be logically separated (tenant-tagged) and never merged into long-term analytic indices.
2) Backup purge timing: Redwood keeps nightly snapshots; any snapshot that contains retained KV logs will be scheduled for purge within 30 days of the documented purge trigger (we will provide a purge timeline and snapshot IDs).
3) Access & audit: access to retained logs requires a multi-approver runbook; requests create an immutable audit entry and are time-limited.

We’ll prepare:
- A proposed erase-runbook PDF showing roles, approvals, and access window controls (will attach shortly).
- A subprocessor list and geo map for any components that may touch the retained material (will highlight cross-border storage).
- A one-page attestation clause Redwood legal can sign for the pilot.

Quick clarifying Qs:
- Will Helios require read exports for debug (downloadable CSV/JSON) or only time-limited viewer access behind our audit UI?
- Any special redaction rules (e.g., remove client PII before export) you need enforced programmatically?

I’ll follow up with the runbook and the subprocessor table today.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@helioshealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 15:44:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retain of inference KV logs (Helios)

Emily / team — Kim from Security. We reviewed the questionnaire and sketched an ops-friendly runbook. Key points and constraints: 

1) Subprocessors and cross-border:
- Primary storage for ephemeral KV logs is in our EU region (GCP eu-west-1). Secondary backups may be stored with our backup subprocessor (SecureVault LLC) which has data centers in US and EU. We can expressly exclude US backup copies for Helios by scoping the tenant-level snapshot policy to EU-only retention; that requires a contract addendum.

2) Snapshot purge timeline: 
- Operationally we create incremental snapshots nightly; full snapshot retention is normally 90 days. For this pilot we will:
  * Tag Helios snapshots and schedule explicit purge jobs.
  * Purge process: mark -> async deletion -> cryptographic tombstone -> physical reclaims in next 30 days.
  * We will provide snapshot IDs and purge status (job id + timestamp) as evidence for each purge.

3) Access & redaction flow:
- Access is limited to named Helios engineers via temporary RBAC token and requires a 2-step approval: Helios security owner + Redwood ops manager.
- Exports: we discourage full data dumps. If exports are required we will programmatically redact fields flagged as PII; we need Helios to provide a redaction mapping (fields to redact).

4) Audit and attestation:
- Each access and purge action is logged (immutable audit) and we will provide a signed attestation after each monthly purge cycle during the pilot.

I’ve attached a proposed runbook PDF (proposed-erase-runbook.pdf) and a draft DPA addendum clause for the EU-scoped backup carveout. If Helios agrees to EU-only backups and the two-step access approvals, we can commit to the 90-day retention and 30-day backup purge SLA for the pilot.

Next steps: Emily — can you confirm the redaction mapping and whether Helios requires downloadable exports? Also please indicate the Helios security owner (name + email) who will be the approver.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: proposed-erase-runbook.pdf (pdf)]

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@helioshealth.com>

Cc: contracting@helioshealth.com, security@helioshealth.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 16:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retain of inference KV logs (Helios)

Thanks — that matches our expectations and is helpful. A few confirmations from Helios side: 

- Helios will accept EU-only backup scoping; we will sign the addendum.
- Redaction mapping: see inline in the attached questionnaire, Helios requires email and SSN-like identifiers redacted on any export. Viewer access for our engineers is preferred; we will only request exports under exceptional bug triage (and will complete the export request form).
- Security owner for approvals: Jordan Mehta, jordan.mehta@helioshealth.com (will be the Helios approver).

Please prepare a one-page attestation we can countersign and a DocuSign envelope for the DPA addendum + backup-scope clause. Contracting will process once the DocuSign is sent (contracting@helioshealth.com).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — if we can get DocuSign sent this week we’ll aim to get the pilot started next Monday.

—Emily
